review_scope: Independent integration and authorization review of uncommitted Phase Two changes. Focus on source/revision continuity, validation and arithmetic, immutable dictionary/rule publication, processing metadata and aggregate-lock boundaries. Earlier task-specific UI and parser reviews were not repeated.
decision_scope: All three confirmed integration findings are addressed in code and bounded reviewer retests. This closes the assigned integration/security review, not the independent statistical review, whole-branch acceptance or production release gate.

findings.title: Unsupported numeric representations and rule arithmetic can escape validation and crash derived views
evidence: Owner CORRECT to raw_value 1e1000000 was accepted and retained. Validation returned only reference_unknown; comparable_cell marked it trend eligible; trend_view with an earlier value 1 raised decimal.Overflow.
Comparator >1e100000000000000000000 was classified as COMPARATOR, but its numeric bound was None; reference_comparison raised TypeError.

An actual candidate review accepted a conversion factor 1e1000000 with matching source method/specimen and known units. Fixed regression passed and publish_dictionary created an active release; comparable_cell on ordinary value 5.2 mapped to that release raised decimal.Overflow.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve raw text while explicitly blocking unsupported representations. Validate numeric rule inputs, fail closed on unsupported calculated results and guard Decimal operations. Include the numeric implementation in parser identity evidence.
fix_evidence: Latest private probe retains 1e1000000 with numeric_unsupported and trend_eligible false; trend calculation does not raise.
The huge comparator returns reference unavailable.
Review of the extreme conversion factor is rejected with ValidationError.

Readback confirms computational bounds and guarded calculations in apps/labs/numerics.py; that file is included in regression parser identity. Reviewer ran validation/comparison tests and the numeric rule-precondition tests.

findings.title: Effective fields must preserve source uncertainty and recompute recoverable quality gates
evidence: An old raw value 62 with association_conflict was deferred. A clean reparse produced automatic 63. KEEP_REVISION retained 62 and its original evidence ID, but validation lost association_conflict and enabled the trend.
A parser-shaped missing-unit SEARCH_ONLY row corrected to known unit 10^9/L still retained unit_unknown and SEARCH_ONLY.
A parser-shaped candidate row corrected to standard_code LAB_WBC still retained mapping_unknown, despite an effective STABLE dictionary identity.

A SEARCH_ONLY row whose recognition_uncertain reason was explicitly resolved by an authorized reviewer had no remaining blocking issue and was directly comparable, yet could never enter a trend because extraction's capability downgrade persisted.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve applicable source/layout/normalization reasons for each retained field; new automatic evidence cannot certify old fields. Recompute mapping and unit restrictions from effective values after correction, and recover only the actual dictionary capability after applicable checks; an intrinsically SEARCH_ONLY dictionary definition must remain restricted.
fix_evidence: Latest private probe retains association_conflict on the old effective value and keeps trend_eligible false.

Private recovery probes now show a corrected known unit, corrected known project and explicitly reviewed recognition error each recover the historical dictionary's STABLE capability with only reference_unknown and trend_eligible true.

Readback confirms capability is restored from dictionary_for_version(effective.mapping_dictionary_version), rather than hard-coding STABLE. New focused tests exercise correction/review recovery and undo.

findings.title: Mutations reuse authorization state obtained before waiting for aggregate or publication locks
evidence: Isolated HTTP CONFIRM probes withdrew is_staff, the review permission, or is_active in the database after lock_observation returned and before its authorization check. Each request returned 302, completed the task and wrote ObservationRevision, although a freshly loaded actor was unauthorized.

Legacy operations.publish_dictionary probes withdrew is_staff, dictionary-manager role membership, or is_active after the real publication lock. Each call still created an active phase-two.json release, although fresh authorize denied the actor.

Code inspection shows candidate review, candidate publication and dictionary rollback also authorize before their mutation locks; candidate source permission alone is not dictionary-manager action authorization.
findings.required_behavior: At mutation boundaries after lock acquisition, check persisted active/staff state and fresh relevant permissions/roles. Cover direct service calls and HTTP entry points, including candidate and legacy publication/rollback paths. Preserve existing task revocation, deletion and expected-version checks.
fix_evidence: Private HTTP probes for staff flag, review permission and active flag withdrawn after aggregate locking now return403, retain IN_PROGRESS and write no ObservationRevision.
Private legacy operations publication probes for staff flag, dictionary role and active flag withdrawn after publication locking now reject with PermissionDenied.

Readback confirms current_actor reloads persisted flags without Django permission caches, review mutations refresh after aggregate locks, candidate/legacy publications and parsing activation reauthorize after locks, candidate publication reauthorizes again and rechecks source grants after fixed regression, and rollback reauthorizes before pointer mutation.
Reviewer ran the focused authorization selection:35 passed,67 deselected in20.40s. Actual PostgreSQL concurrency verification belongs to the designated worker.

verification.final_private_probe_result: All original defect symptoms resolved. The private SQLite revocation hooks execute inside the enclosing transaction, so rejection rolls their synthetic withdrawal back too; any freshly authorized actor reported after rejection reflects that rollback, while the denied mutation is the observed outcome.

Candidate source queries constrain all grant conditions to the same review task and require active source versions and active owner accounts.
